origin: Trial-4 (2026-10-07): cold-successor knowledge trial claimed PASS on summary statistics; raw data lived at /tmp/trial4/RESULTS.md on an ephemeral session tmpfs, was wiped on reboot, and Naya 2's independent verification returned INCONCLUSIVE. The claim could never be re-verified. This spec makes that failure class impossible.

descriptor.description: Machine-readable claim envelope the verifier checks.

claim.description: The verifiable claim, e.g. PASS with effect size.

raw_evidence_paths.description: Paths to raw evidence. Relative paths resolve against the repository root and MUST be committed. Absolute paths MUST be inside the repository root.

rules.durable_location: Every trial claim MUST cite its raw evidence at paths committed to a repository branch BEFORE the claim is posted. A claim whose raw evidence exists only on ephemeral storage is UNVERIFIABLE by construction.
forbidden_locations: any absolute path outside the repository root
any session-scoped tmpfs or scratch directory
rules.verifier: tools/verify_trial_evidence.py implements this spec's conformance predicate. It FAILS CLOSED: any unresolvable, ephemeral, or out-of-repo evidence path fails the whole claim. A verifier that cannot fail is not a verifier.

statement: A trial claim is verifiable only if its raw evidence is durably preserved. Summary statistics alone are not verification. /tmp is not an evidence store.
title: TRIAL-EVIDENCE-V1
